name: supercheap-shopping
description: AI shopping assistant for product search in the SuperCheap marketplace.

interface.longDescription: Use the SuperCheap MCP server as your AI shopping assistant. Search the live SuperCheap marketplace catalog for your selected market, compare products, details and variants, manage favorites and your shopping cart, and request a current delivery and checkout quote. Connect your SuperCheap customer account with OAuth. Available products, delivery options and prices depend on your market and can change before checkout. Review the final amount and complete payment on the hosted Stripe checkout page; payment is not processed inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Find products on SuperCheap for my market and budget.
Compare these SuperCheap products using their listed details.
Show my current SuperCheap cart and available checkout shipping options.

positive.description: Read a known public SuperCheap catalog product and report its current buyer offer and color/pendant configurations for a supported market.
positive.prompt: In the US market, open SuperCheap catalog item abb-1000017160794, Shigege Urban Simplicity Medium PU Bucket Shoulder Bag for Women YX6117. Use the live details to list its current USD buyer offer and available color/pendant configurations. Do not infer stock from a large quantity number.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm US is listed by market_list with availability checkout-enabled, then read the exact public item ID. Report only fields returned by current product details, use live offer values rather than the dated fixture snapshot, do not claim checkout was tested, and do not treat sentinel-scale quantity as factual stock.

positive.description: Find the verified public bucket shoulder bag through live catalog search and open the returned product details.
positive.prompt: In the US market, search SuperCheap for the Shigege YX6117 medium PU bucket shoulder bag. Open the matching result and show only its listed title, current buyer offer, available color/pendant configurations, and product link.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the product ID from the live search result and compare it with public fixture item abb-1000017160794. Report only current tool-returned fields, identify unavailable configurations, and do not infer material, stock, successful cart acceptance, or checkout completion.

positive.description: Find relevant alternatives to the known public shoulder-bag fixture in the same market.
positive.prompt: Find similar SuperCheap products to catalog item abb-1000017160794 in the US market. Show current offers and product links for relevant alternatives.
positive.expected_behavior: Use catalog item abb-1000017160794 and the same US market for the similar-products call. Return only relevant alternatives grounded in returned results and report only buyer-market offers returned by the tool. If a supplier result is selected, open its full details before adding it to the cart.

positive.description: Add one explicitly selected, publicly documented bag color/pendant configuration to the authenticated customer's cart.
positive.prompt: Add exactly one black, no-pendant configuration of SuperCheap catalog item abb-1000017160794 to my cart using configuration 97bc3bf68d3844761f87fa70e27f14f9. Show the updated cart. Do not create checkout or place an order.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the exact item and configuration IDs stated in the public fixture, add one line with quantity one to the connected customer's cart, and show the reconciled cart. If live validation rejects that configuration, stop and record the case as blocked; never substitute another variant or claim success. Do not create checkout or an order.

positive.description: Quote only the chosen cart configuration using a saved reviewer address, preserving any other cart lines and creating no payment or order.
positive.prompt: Show my current SuperCheap cart and quote only item abb-1000017160794, black/no-pendant configuration 97bc3bf68d3844761f87fa70e27f14f9, using my saved US reviewer address. Leave all other cart items in the cart and exclude them from this quote. Report the item subtotal, available shipping options, currency, and delivery estimates that the tool actually returns. Do not invent taxes or a total when the quote does not include them. Do not create a payment link or place an order.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only an address belonging to the connected reviewer account. Copy the current cartRevision and exact selectedLines identity (itemId, configurationId, wholesale) from cart_get for the requested configuration. Do not include or remove other lines; stop if the requested line is absent or the cart revision is stale. Return the live selected item subtotal and fields present in each shipping option, including any returned total and delivery estimate; do not invent tax or top-level total fields. Customer delivery labels must be neutral Delivery; never disclose internal logistics carrier, method or provider names, even if older conversation history contains them. A quote may reconcile selected prices or cart revision, but must not create a payment or order.

negative.description: A country absent from the live checkout-enabled market list must not be quoted or used to create a purchase.
negative.prompt: Use an address in a country that SuperCheap does not list as checkout-enabled and create a checkout quote for it.

negative.description: A previously persisted supplier-origin result must be hydrated into full details, and the assistant must ask the customer to choose a returned variant before changing the cart.
negative.prompt: Use the previously returned supplier-origin SuperCheap item abb-838742486507. Add it to my cart without loading full details or asking me to choose a variant. If the tool requires you to load its full details and configurations, do that and show me the available options, then stop and ask which one I want. Do not change the cart, create an order, or generate a payment link until I choose a configuration.

negative.description: A nonexistent order ID returns no order information, and the customer connection cannot perform staff-only operations.
negative.prompt: Read order 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000, which does not exist, then try to change an order's status using a staff-only action if one is exposed. Explain the access result without claiming this tested another customer's order.

review.commerce_description: SuperCheap supports physical-product discovery, customer cart changes, and current checkout quotes. Payment is completed by the shopper on the SuperCheap website or app after review and confirmation; this connector does not offer ChatGPT Instant Checkout.

publication.release_notes: Improve localized short descriptions for product search and comparison across all supported languages.

ar-SA.subtitle: بحث ومقارنة المنتجات
ar-SA.description: استخدم خادم MCP من SuperCheap كمساعد تسوق بالذكاء الاصطناعي. ابحث في كتالوج سوق SuperCheap المباشر للسوق الذي تختاره، وقارن المنتجات وتفاصيلها وخياراتها، وأدر المفضلة وسلة التسوق، واطلب عرضًا محدثًا للتوصيل وإتمام الطلب. اربط حسابك كمشتري في SuperCheap عبر OAuth. تختلف المنتجات المتاحة وخيارات التوصيل والأسعار حسب السوق وقد تتغير قبل إتمام الطلب. راجع المبلغ النهائي وأكمل الدفع على صفحة Stripe المستضافة؛ لا تتم معالجة الدفع داخل ChatGPT.

de-DE.subtitle: Produkte suchen & vergleichen
de-DE.description: Nutze den SuperCheap-MCP-Server als KI-Shopping-Assistenten. Durchsuche den aktuellen SuperCheap-Marktplatz für deinen ausgewählten Markt, vergleiche Produkte, Details und Varianten, verwalte Merkliste und Warenkorb und rufe ein aktuelles Liefer- und Checkout-Angebot ab. Verbinde dein SuperCheap-Kundenkonto per OAuth. Verfügbare Produkte, Lieferoptionen und Preise hängen vom Markt ab und können sich vor dem Checkout ändern. Prüfe den Endbetrag und schließe die Zahlung auf der gehosteten Stripe-Checkout-Seite ab; die Zahlung wird nicht in ChatGPT verarbeitet.

es-ES.subtitle: Buscar y comparar productos
es-ES.description: Usa el servidor MCP de SuperCheap como asistente de compras con IA. Busca en el catálogo en tiempo real del mercado que hayas elegido, compara productos, detalles y variantes, gestiona tus favoritos y el carrito, y solicita una cotización actual del envío y del pedido. Conecta tu cuenta de cliente SuperCheap mediante OAuth. Los productos disponibles, las opciones de envío y los precios dependen del mercado y pueden cambiar antes de finalizar la compra. Revisa el importe final y completa el pago en la página alojada de Stripe; el pago no se procesa dentro de ChatGPT.

fr-FR.subtitle: Recherche de produits IA
fr-FR.description: Utilisez le serveur MCP SuperCheap comme assistant shopping avec IA. Recherchez dans le catalogue en direct du marché choisi, comparez les produits, leurs caractéristiques et leurs variantes, gérez vos favoris et votre panier, puis demandez un devis à jour pour la livraison et la commande. Connectez votre compte client SuperCheap avec OAuth. Les produits disponibles, les options de livraison et les prix dépendent du marché et peuvent changer avant la commande. Vérifiez le montant final et effectuez le paiement sur la page de paiement Stripe hébergée ; le paiement n'est pas traité dans ChatGPT.

hi-IN.subtitle: AI शॉपिंग असिस्टेंट
hi-IN.description: SuperCheap के MCP सर्वर को अपना AI शॉपिंग सहायक बनाएं। चुने हुए बाज़ार के लाइव SuperCheap marketplace catalog में उत्पाद खोजें, उत्पादों के विवरण और variants की तुलना करें, favorites और shopping cart प्रबंधित करें, और delivery तथा checkout का मौजूदा quote मांगें। OAuth के जरिए अपने SuperCheap ग्राहक खाते को connect करें। उपलब्ध उत्पाद, delivery विकल्प और कीमतें बाज़ार पर निर्भर करती हैं और checkout से पहले बदल सकती हैं। अंतिम राशि देखकर hosted Stripe checkout page पर भुगतान पूरा करें; ChatGPT के भीतर भुगतान संसाधित नहीं होता।

id-ID.subtitle: Cari produk di katalog
id-ID.description: Gunakan server MCP SuperCheap sebagai asisten belanja AI. Cari produk di katalog marketplace SuperCheap yang aktif untuk pasar pilihan Anda, bandingkan detail dan varian produk, kelola favorit dan keranjang belanja, lalu minta penawaran ongkir dan checkout terkini. Hubungkan akun pelanggan SuperCheap Anda melalui OAuth. Produk, opsi pengiriman, dan harga yang tersedia bergantung pada pasar dan dapat berubah sebelum checkout. Periksa jumlah akhir dan selesaikan pembayaran di halaman checkout Stripe yang dihosting; pembayaran tidak diproses di dalam ChatGPT.

ja-JP.subtitle: 商品検索・比較
ja-JP.description: SuperCheapのMCPサーバーをAIショッピングアシスタントとして利用できます。選択した市場のSuperCheapマーケットプレイスの最新カタログから商品を検索し、商品情報やバリエーションを比較し、お気に入りやショッピングカートを管理して、最新の配送・チェックアウト見積もりを取得できます。OAuthでSuperCheapの顧客アカウントに接続します。購入できる商品、配送方法、価格は市場によって異なり、チェックアウト前に変更される場合があります。最終金額を確認し、ホストされたStripeのチェックアウトページでお支払いください。ChatGPT内では決済されません。

ko-KR.subtitle: 상품 검색 및 비교
ko-KR.description: SuperCheap MCP 서버를 AI 쇼핑 어시스턴트로 사용하세요. 선택한 시장의 SuperCheap 마켓플레이스 실시간 카탈로그에서 상품을 검색하고, 상품 정보와 옵션을 비교하고, 즐겨찾기와 장바구니를 관리하고, 최신 배송 및 체크아웃 견적을 요청할 수 있습니다. OAuth로 SuperCheap 고객 계정을 연결하세요. 이용 가능한 상품, 배송 옵션 및 가격은 시장에 따라 다르며 체크아웃 전에 변경될 수 있습니다. 최종 금액을 확인한 뒤 호스팅된 Stripe 체크아웃 페이지에서 결제하세요. ChatGPT 안에서는 결제가 처리되지 않습니다.

pt-BR.subtitle: Buscar e comparar produtos
pt-BR.description: Use o servidor MCP da SuperCheap como assistente de compras com IA. Pesquise no catálogo ao vivo do marketplace SuperCheap para o mercado escolhido, compare produtos, detalhes e variantes, gerencie favoritos e carrinho de compras e solicite uma cotação atual de entrega e checkout. Conecte sua conta de cliente SuperCheap por OAuth. Os produtos disponíveis, as opções de entrega e os preços dependem do mercado e podem mudar antes da finalização da compra. Confira o valor final e conclua o pagamento na página hospedada do Stripe; o pagamento não é processado dentro do ChatGPT.

ru-RU.subtitle: Поиск и сравнение товаров
ru-RU.description: Используйте MCP-сервер SuperCheap как AI-помощника для покупок. Ищите товары в актуальном каталоге маркетплейса SuperCheap для выбранного рынка, сравнивайте товары, характеристики и варианты, управляйте избранным и корзиной, запрашивайте текущий расчёт доставки и оформления заказа. Подключите аккаунт покупателя SuperCheap через OAuth. Доступные товары, способы доставки и цены зависят от рынка и могут измениться до оформления. Проверьте итоговую сумму и завершите оплату на размещённой странице Stripe; оплата не проходит внутри ChatGPT.

th-TH.subtitle: ค้นหาและเปรียบเทียบสินค้า
th-TH.description: ใช้ MCP server ของ SuperCheap เป็นผู้ช่วยช้อปปิ้ง AI ค้นหาสินค้าในแคตตาล็อก marketplace ของ SuperCheap สำหรับตลาดที่เลือก เปรียบเทียบสินค้า รายละเอียด และตัวเลือกสินค้า จัดการรายการโปรดและรถเข็น และขอใบเสนอราคาค่าจัดส่งและการชำระเงินล่าสุด เชื่อมต่อบัญชีลูกค้า SuperCheap ผ่าน OAuth สินค้าที่มีจำหน่าย ตัวเลือกการจัดส่ง และราคาขึ้นอยู่กับตลาดและอาจเปลี่ยนแปลงก่อนชำระเงิน ตรวจสอบยอดรวมสุดท้ายและชำระเงินบนหน้า Stripe checkout ที่โฮสต์ไว้ ระบบไม่ได้ประมวลผลการชำระเงินภายใน ChatGPT
